E0.population: eligible_training_candidates_only; repeated context rows and distance pairs are dependent
E0.pool_metrics: cosine nn1 mean/max and nn3 mean; selected people have nn1=0 but generally nn3>0
E0.outlier_measure: mean distance to other eligible candidates; a descriptive percentile, not a quality exclusion

E1.global_loso_definition: mean cosine distance to every other corpus person with complete same-eight-prompt neutral references; never selected by outcomes
E1.uar_aggregation: existing core_score.collect_draws pools six rotations' class counts, computes fixed-six-class UAR, then averages three draw UARs; raw logits not replayed here
E1.distance_aggregation: equal mean over six rotations within draw, then three draws
E1.reference_query_scope: disjoint within each historical unit; a reference may be a query in another rotation
